mission: The Ben/Desh conversation about Jacen and GAG — the first honest acknowledgment of what they experienced. Emotional excavation of shared trauma.
why_now: Desh has been building to this since Chapter 1. The Corridor's pressure and the historical parallels have made it unavoidable.
conflict: Both men have been carrying GAG shame for years without discussing it. Desh forces the conversation because the pattern is repeating: an authoritative figure (now Torin) whose certainty feels familiar in a way that should be alarming.
turning_point: Desh names it: 'He sounds like Jacen. The good version. Before.' Ben's stomach drops because Desh just said what Ben has been refusing to think.
opening_hook: Desh doesn't start with Jacen. He starts with a specific day — a raid they both remember, an arrest that went wrong, a face Ben sees when he can't sleep.
closing_hook: Neither of them says 'we should watch Torin.' They don't need to. The conversation has planted the pattern recognition that will pay off in Chapter 18.
emotional_trajectory: Careful approach -> painful honesty -> shared understanding without resolution

stakes.personal: Ben confronting the worst chapter of his life with the only person who shared it
stakes.interpersonal: Ben/Desh relationship deepening from friendship to genuine trust forged in acknowledged shame
stakes.external: The Jacen pattern recognition will become critical tactical intelligence

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — cockpit, night cycle, dim lighting
sensory_details: Dim instrument lights; the quiet of a ship where everyone else is sleeping; Desh's hands on the controls — steady, the way they always are; the weight of shared memory making the cockpit feel smaller
action_beats: Desh keeps his hands steady on the flight controls while describing the raid they both remember
Ben's fingers tighten on the armrest when Desh names the pattern — Torin sounding like the good version of Jacen
Both men stare at instrument readouts they aren't reading through a long silence
promises_paid: Ben and Desh share unspoken GAG history (PP02)
notes: Critical emotional scene. Jacen parallel touchpoint 2 (emotional). The conversation enables Ben's pattern recognition in Ch 18. Desh's arc: lie_challenged — the honest reckoning with their shared history shows him he cares about more than a favor.
